svg.title: BS&T railway and facilities
svg.desc: Blood, Sweat & Tears Railway Company — Taylor, Wyoming — Hauls industrial freight by rail between Wamsutter and Taylor.; BS&T main line — Wamsutter–Taylor, Wyoming — Carries freight between Wamsutter interchange and Taylor’s industrial facilities.; East Materials branch — Sweetwater County, Wyoming — Connects the main line to East Materials rail customers.; Mineral Transfer branch — Sweetwater County, Wyoming — Connects the main line to mineral-loading facilities.
